WITH linked AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON ab.translink = t.transreg
  JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
),
counts AS (
  SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM linked
  GROUP BY transreg, tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT transreg, tradekind, cnt,
         cnt::numeric / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(cnt) AS avg_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share
FROM shares
GROUP BY tradekind;
